lines: As mover, karma could be primal-natured even.
Then here — where is Īśvara's work to be conceived?
l4.sanskrit_cite: nimittakāraṇaṃ karma syādapyādyasvabhāvataḥ tato'tra kutra vyāpāra īśvarasyopakalpyatām

reads_against.argmap: As efficient cause (nimittakāraṇaṃ), karma (karma) could be (syāt) even (api) original-natured (ādya-svabhāvataḥ). / Then (tatas) here (atra) — where (kutra) is Īśvara's business (vyāpāraḥ) to be conceived (upakalpyatām)? / Prose: karma-as-nimitta considered and bounded; the question turns the page. → Pivot: karma admitted as possible nimitta — then where is Īśvara's business?
c1_essence: Sāṅkhya stated at full strength: pradhāna proved by presence, purposed by denying self-aims; change easy; only striving moves; nature faces down (vv19-22).
The page turns on admitted karma: where is His business? Let His triggering be conceived; seed imaged; Sāṅkhya godless; conditional close (vv23-27).
